notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
We added a few improvements to the Total Score leaderboard introduced in the last update.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug on the Total Score leaderboard where names could overlap the scores.
[*]Updated copyright date.
[*]A few other minor tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Today we are releasing a small patch with some bits of polish we added as we prepared the game for release on mobile.
If you'd like to play some Cake on the go, Defend the Cake is now available on the App Store and Google Play!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a Total Score leaderboard. If you complete at least one Score Attack, you will see your Total Score (sum of your high scores across all levels) on the World Map.
[*]Made the Spice Gem easier to click on, and gave it some more pizzazz.
[*]Made the Rolling Pin Ramp easier to click on.
[*]Some minor UI tweaks.
[*]Performance optimizations.
[*]A few other minor tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Launch!
notes.content:
The wait is over, Defend the Cake has popped out of the oven! Thank you so much to everyone who gave us feedback and reported bugs in Early Access!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]All enemies are now animated
[*]Added more animation to the Eggbirds
[*]Added a button that allows you to speed the game up during Night
[*]Added UI that displays all of the waves for the level. Click on the wave UI for the current level to bring it up.
[*]Tweaked the balance on the Killer Queen level, including significantly buffing Queen Antoinette’s HP. The leaderboard for this level has been reset due to these changes.
[*]Did a pass on tooltips and almanac text
[*]Changed the speed value for enemies in the almanac to a number
[*]Final audio pass
[*]UI tweaks
[*]Lots of other little bits of polish!
[/list]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed some issues where tower launch points were off
[*]Fixed an issue where the Caterpillar’s transform animation would not play at the correct speed
[/list]

notes.title: Second major Early Access update!
notes.content:
We just deployed our second major update for Defend the Cake. Here's what we've been working on:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]The following enemies now have animations!
- Drone Bee
- Super Worm
- Caterpillar/Butterfly
- Jetpack Grasshopper
- Armored Beetle
[*]Added a death animation for the Worm
[*]When you rewind to the previous day, your Eggbirds will now be assigned to whatever jobs they had when you clicked Ready
- Due to changes made to the save file format, unfortunately all Replay Score Attack saves had to be reset. Sorry about that!
[*]If you exit a level before completing it, you will now be able to resume where you left off
[*]Updated the art on the Anthill
[*]Updated some Eggbird art
[*]The Butterfly will now show the path it will take to the cake
[*]Tweaked the sand on the Pineapple levels to make the playable space more clear
[*]Added a graphics quality setting
[*]Added new sounds, and updated some existing ones
[*]Added some tutorial messages to explain new mechanics when they appear
[*]Balance tweaks
[/list]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Strawberry Shooters would get visually stuck in their powered up state when being webbed by a Spider
[*]Fixed an issue where multiple Spiders could shoot webs at the same structure
[*]Fixed an issue where Eggbirds could overlap in odd ways during the day
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes enemy death animations would not play if an enemy of that type had previously stolen a cake slice
[/list]

notes.title: First major update!
notes.content:
We just deployed our first major update for Defend the Cake. Here's what we've been working on:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Worms now spawn in Score Attack!  Each Spice collected in Score Attack will add a +0.25x multiplier to your score per second. Unused or uncollected Spice does not carry over into Score Attack.
[*]Environment art update
[*]Additional Wheat has been added to the following levels:
- Let it Bee
- Metamorphosis
- Crabby Road
- Webslingers
- Killer Queen
Score Attack Replay saves have been reset for these levels.
[*]Tweaked the Score Attack spawns on some levels.
[*]Removed the Display setting. You can change the display the game runs on by moving the game window to that display.
[*]Made the error text in tooltips easier to read.
[*]Hooked up some upgrade states for Defenses.
[*]All enemies that get hit by a Watermelon will now display some hit FX.
[*]Removed the flame icon from Defenses. Hooked up some new stuff to better illustrate the Power Up cooldown.
[*]Performance optimizations.
[/list]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*]The “Place the Cake” hint will no longer show up when you replay score attack for a level.
[*]Watermelons should now do a better job of hitting Worms.
[*]Upgraded Cheese Knives will now properly apply the damage over time effect on Power Up.
[*]Cheese Knives will now properly rotate to face their target on Power Up.
[*]Fixed issue where the score/sec would jump down for the moment between when a flyer grabbed a slice from the Cake and when the flyer arrived at the end of the ground path.
[*]Toast walls will no longer pop up when rewinding to the previous day.
[*]Fixed some sprite layering issues.
[*]Fixed an issue where a Butterfly would not path correctly if the Caterpillar reached an empty cake and turned around before turning into a Butterfly.
[*]Fixed text overlap on the new thing unlocked UI.
[*]Fixed an issue where death animations would freeze if the enemy was stunned.
[*]Spiders will no longer fire webs while carrying cake.
[/list]
